reason: Board entry test-tiers says zero discovered tests is a failure; decision D7 in the test-tiers decision record keeps that only for whole unfiltered runs (as a min_tests floor) and lets a narrower run (computed, --base, --card or explicit scope, or words after --) that discovers zero tests pass with a warning, since such a scope can legitimately hold no tests. Should a narrower zero-test run fail as the board says, or pass with a warning as D7 says?
